description: Four optional families, no implemented or live-verified adapters. Models/deployments are operator-configured, not a bundled or interchangeable universal model catalog.

routingContract.fallback: Only an explicitly approved ordered list with equivalent or stricter data and capability policy. Reject cycles, missing profiles and local/offline to hosted transitions. Audit each fallback; no automatic cross-mode recovery.
routingContract.quotaKey: Actual organization/project/account/model-class/region/deployment limit scope, not merely an API key. Different profiles can consume the same shared limit.
routingContract.retry: One bounded retry owner, inclusive of SDK attempts. Honor Retry-After within the job deadline; use bounded backoff/jitter, release connections while waiting and show queued/blocked/exhausted states.
routingContract.retention: Minimal redacted context; local prompt and result expiry are separate from provider storage/logging/caching/account policies. A requested store=false or zero-day local retention is not a universal provider zero-retention guarantee.

profiles.setupRecipe: Planned: choose a project endpoint/model, reference a restricted backend credential, select permitted workspaces/tasks/data classes, declare the account's retention and request/token limits, obtain explicit outbound approval and approve a synthetic capability check. No source code is sent by default.

liveVerification.reason: No adapter implementation or authorized provider project/model check. Documentation and schema fixtures are not evidence of model availability, usage correctness or retention settings.

verificationPlan.environment: An operator-authorized OpenAI test project and explicitly selected model with a finite test budget; synthetic prompts only.

profiles.apiFlavor: Azure OpenAI v1 routes in Microsoft Foundry; explicitly selected compatible deployment, not every Foundry model
profiles.setupRecipe: Planned: select the resource endpoint and deployment independently of the requested model, select protected key or authorized workload identity, review region/deployment processing policy and shared quota scope, then approve synthetic request and capability checks for the permitted workspaces/tasks. Do not insert a universal dated api-version into every Foundry endpoint.

liveVerification.reason: No Foundry adapter, authorized resource or selected deployment was tested. Endpoint privacy and deployment naming do not establish geography, retention or model compatibility.

verificationPlan.environment: Operator-authorized Azure OpenAI resource in a declared tenant/region with one explicitly compatible deployment and constrained key or workload identity.

profiles.apiFlavor: Native Messages API /v1/messages, anthropic-version 2023-06-01; no unreviewed beta headers
profiles.setupRecipe: Planned: select the Messages endpoint and operator model ID, reference the backend key, approve allowed tasks/data and provider-specific retention, configure quota/deadline bounds and authorize a synthetic Messages capability run. Preserve native content-block, stop-reason and usage semantics rather than coercing an OpenAI-shaped response.

liveVerification.reason: No Anthropic adapter or authorized model run exists. Exact output behavior, available capabilities and account controls remain unverified.

verificationPlan.environment: Operator-authorized Anthropic test workspace/key and selected model, using only synthetic prompts within a finite spend policy.

profiles.apiFlavor: Ollama native /api/chat; runtime and model versions must be explicitly selected for the authorized pilot
profiles.setupRecipe: Planned: point at a private operator-managed Ollama runtime, explicitly select a locally present reviewed model, configure finite local resource limits and deny hosted egress on both worker and inference runtime. Authorize a synthetic native-protocol check; no cloud model, implicit model download or hosted fallback is permitted.

liveVerification.reason: No native adapter, runtime/model pair or enforced local-only network profile has been tested. A loopback address or downloadable weights are not verification.

verificationPlan.environment: Operator-authorized private CPU/GPU test host with explicitly selected runtime and locally present model, outbound hosted traffic denied independently of the aspm worker.

runtime.reason: No exact executable/container distribution selected. Review the runtime version, dependencies and notices independently before bundling.

modelSystem.reason: No model system selected. Review terms, weights, code, training/data information and redistribution/openness requirements separately; runtime licensing does not approve the model.

profiles.apiFlavor: Operator-managed local /v1/chat/completions compatibility profile; not an OpenAI hosted fallback
profiles.setupRecipe: Planned: select a private compatible runtime endpoint and reviewed local model, provide a protected auth reference if required, enforce deny-hosted egress at both boundaries and approve individual synthetic capability checks. Reject unsupported tools/structured output visibly rather than silently forwarding to a hosted API.

liveVerification.reason: No compatible adapter or authorized runtime/model pair was exercised. OpenAI-compatible transport is not universal model, usage, streaming or cancellation compatibility.

verificationPlan.environment: Operator-authorized private inference runtime with a declared version/model and controlled network-denial fixtures; no third-party inference calls.

runtime.reason: Compatibility protocol does not identify an executable or license; an exact runtime distribution and dependency inventory are required.

modelSystem.reason: No bundled model or openness/redistribution review. Available weights are not approval of the entire model system.

promotionPolicy: Each exact profile/model/deployment needs implemented status, deterministic conformance evidence and a separately authorized timestamped live evidence file before supported/readyToConnect. Stochastic quality evaluation is separate and may be inconclusive. An independent reviewer checks provenance; JSON tests cannot authenticate the record.
